config.design: Fixed support768/splits/source assignments, output rank16. Compare empirical input rank64/128 and optimization budgets8/32. Rank64 replays H471 joint initialization; rank128 gets same normalized joint state/response least-squares initialization. Same full-gradient finite-response KL and fraction grid, SVD rebalancing, validation-only selection over prefixes0..8 and0..32. Both widths complete32 steps before test. Primary width128-minus64 at32 gain>.05 each sign, budget32-minus8 gain>.05 each sign at each width, and rank128/budget32 absolute deltaKL>.8 each sign. Joint8 standardized document bootstrap. Intact/CE and interaction descriptive. No new corpus; histories reused. No convergence claim from last-step selection.
